enabled.name: Enable addon
enabled.description: Master switch for TIDAL detection and the nametag line.

showMusicStatus.name: Show music status
showMusicStatus.description: Shows a music line when usable TIDAL metadata is available.

showOwnStatus.name: Show own status
showOwnStatus.description: Enables the music line for your local player.

showWhenPaused.name: Show while paused
showWhenPaused.description: Keeps the current track visible while TIDAL is paused.

showPauseSymbol.name: Use pause symbol
showPauseSymbol.description: Replaces the music symbol with a pause symbol while paused.

showMusicIcon.name: Show visual tile
showMusicIcon.description: Shows the cover or the animated equalizer fallback on the left.

modernNametag.name: Modern two-line design
modernNametag.description: Shows title and artist as a compact now-playing card with an equalizer.

animateNametag.name: Enable animations
animateNametag.description: Animates the equalizer and smoothly moves text that is too long.

displayTrackCover.name: Show TIDAL cover
displayTrackCover.description: Uses the cover supplied by the local Windows media session.

animationSpeedMillis.name: Animation interval (ms)
animationSpeedMillis.description: Lower values produce a faster animation.

nametagScalePercent.name: Nametag size (%)
nametagScalePercent.description: Scales the complete card relative to its compact default size.

displayFormat.name: Display format
displayFormat.description: Used by the classic one-line design. Placeholders: {icon}, {artist}, {title}, {separator}, {status}

maxTextLength.name: Maximum text length
maxTextLength.description: Long lines scroll in the modern design and are shortened in the classic design.

updateIntervalMillis.name: Update interval (ms)
updateIntervalMillis.description: How often the background worker reads the Windows media session.

shareWithOthers.name: Share with other players
shareWithOthers.description: Reserved for version 2. Local-only version 1 never sends data.

debugMode.name: Debug mode
debugMode.description: Writes additional, rate-limited diagnostic messages to the game log.
